jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


In Amazon Stores, we ship some of the widest arrays of technology found at any company. From Amazon.com to world class machine learning pipelines, from digital healthcare to no\-checkout retail, we push the boundaries of technology in every direction using the globe’s largest AWS deployment.  

  

As a Security Engineer, you will collaborate with software development teams to ensure we keep our customers safe while developing these novel services. In a given day, you might be inspecting an application’s code for security issues, building a new framework to help our software developers build faster and more securely, or fine\-tuning the design for a new service alongside its software developers.  

  

The ideal candidate combines technical acumen with an ability to lead by influence and communicate clearly. Technically, this person will be a security generalist with one or more areas of deep expertise. In their communication, they will clearly articulate risks to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. Interpersonally, successful candidates will effectively harmonize disparate opinions while effectively  

prioritizing risks to guide their partners towards secure solutions.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define and drive implementation of proactive security controls for SDO's most critical, Ring 0 applications
* Evaluated and implement security controls, ensuring Ring 0 developers build secure applications by default
* Assess and drive mitigation of security risks
* Build and/or drive adoption of security tooling (e.g., automated threat modeling, code scanning, security test generation) to scale security across SDO AppSec
* Drive adoption of security guardrails, testing frameworks, and monitoring across Ring 0 applications
* Collaborate with Ring 0 builder teams to integrate security guidance into development workflows, reducing late\-stage security findings
* Develop and maintain security documentation including threat models, risk assessments, and secure development guidelines
* Support security incident investigations related to Ring 0 systems
* Performing manual and automated secure code review (Java, Python, JavaScript)
* Identifying and mitigating security issues at scale
* Performing adversarial security analysis
* Providing security guidance to internal development teams, stakeholders, and business leaders
* Independently solving complex security problems

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connected Fleet & Operations
jobs.description:
About The Landline Company  


Landline is building infrastructure that lets passengers clear security and check in for their flight closer to home, before they ever reach the airport. We provide seamless ground connectivity on behalf of American Airlines, Air Canada, and other major carriers, integrating booking, secure transport, and baggage handling into a single ticket across a growing North American network.  


Backed by top\-tier venture investors and partners like CLEAR, we've spent eight years making the travel day seamless for millions of passengers.  


Job Summary  


Our drivers and frontline teams run a live 24/7 operation across a growing North American network, and the tools in their hands have to work the first time, even for someone who got hired last week.  


As a Software Engineer, you'll own that layer. That includes the driver app at the center of every trip, the handheld tools our station staff run their shifts on, and the connections back into the platform, from booking systems to the operations backend, that keep everyone in sync in real time.  


Our operation runs inside the networks of major airline partners like American Airlines and Air Canada. You'll work at hub airports and partner stations, alongside their teams and ours, watching how the operation actually runs. When you find something slow, manual, or error\-prone, you'll ship the fix and iterate on it in days rather than quarters.  


We work on a modern, engineer\-friendly stack and build agentic workflows into how we develop and how our tools run, and you'll have a real voice in where it goes next.  


What You'll Do  


Own the field software layer: the driver app and the handheld tools frontline staff use every shift for scanning, verification, photo capture, and real\-time status.  
Design flows that hold up in real field conditions, including offline use, glare, gloves, and one\-handed operation.  
Integrate device capabilities like camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS so field events are verifiable and auditable without slowing anyone down.  
Integrate IoT and vehicle telematics, working with platforms like Samsara, so vehicle, device, and operational data flow into one real\-time picture of the operation.  
Work across the platform when the problem calls for it, from booking flows to dispatch visibility to the operations backend, so field tools and core systems behave as one product.  
Use and build agentic workflows. We rely on LLM\-driven tooling in development and in production, and we want people who are excited to push that further.  
Deploy forward: ride along with drivers, work station shifts at partner hub airports, and ship the fix that week. Your users include our own teams and the airline partner staff we operate alongside.  


What We're Looking For  


Production Android experience shipping and maintained an Android app real users depend on  
Experience in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose is preferred.  
You know how to build for spotty connectivity and make sync conflicts boring, with offline\-first instincts.  
Device and IoT integration experience with camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS.  
Experience with telematics/IoT platforms (Samsara or similar), rugged devices, or BLE sensors is a plus.  
Modern web fluency in a Next.js/Vercel environment working across the stack when a feature needs it.  
Agentic or automation experience is a plus, whether that's LLM\-driven workflows, orchestration, or process automation that real users depend on.  
Secure\-by\-design instincts as we operate in a security\-regulated environment and build to federal\-grade standards, so data integrity, least privilege, and auditability should come naturally to you.  
Forward\-deployed experience embedded with users or operations teams (as an FDE, in solutions engineering, or on internal tools in a physical\-ops business) and you're at your best turning messy operational reality into shipped software.  
Comfortable reaching into backend services or web frontends when the fix lives there, across the stack.  
A travel or logistics startup background is a plus, and familiarity with regulated data environments will speed up your ramp.  


Why Join  


Impact — Ground\-floor ownership of tools a live operation depends on every day  
Proximity — You'll watch drivers use what you built the same week you shipped it  
Culture — A small, ambitious team that values speed, creativity, autonomy, and bias for action  


What We Offer  


Global flight privileges through airline partners  
Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment (with regular travel to stations in the USA and Canada, including Montréal, Boston, Denver, and Philadelphia)  
Competitive salary, 401(k), and PTO  
Medical, dental, vision, and company\-paid life insurance  
The opportunity to contribute to sustainable transportation and redefine how people travel  


Location: Remote, with occasional travel to station locations in the USA and Canada  


Time Zone: EST or CST  


Pay Band: $100,000 – $120,000  


Job Type: Full Time Salary, Exempt  


The Landline Company is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the HR Product Team**
-----------------------------


The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire.


We operate at the critical intersection of HR, compliance, and enterprise software. Our products manage the most sensitive and essential aspects of a company's relationship with its people, requiring us to solve complex problems related to scale, data security, and multi\-product integration.

### **What We Build**


The team is composed of high\-impact squads focused on four core domains:

* **HRIS (Human Resources Information System):** Building the core employee record, organizational structure, and workflows that serve as the single source of truth for all other Rippling products.
* **Time:** Developing accurate, scalable, and globally compliant Time \& Attendance systems, including clocking, time\-off accrual, and scheduling, ensuring employees are paid correctly and legally.
* **Benefits:** Creating and maintaining the marketplace and administration tools for health, retirement, and other employee benefits, handling complex enrollment, eligibility, and provider integrations.
* **Talent:** Designing products that manage employee growth, performance, and learning, helping companies develop and retain their workforce effectively.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Design and implement features with an emphasis on backend logic, API development, and data integrity, while also contributing to the frontend implementation.
* Work across the stack, focusing on API design, event modeling, and robust data management while ensuring a seamless connection to the user interface.
* Own the full development lifecycle for features, ensuring that the backend architecture supports both reliable functionality and excellent frontend performance.
* Work closely with cross\-functional partners to understand requirements, refine technical scope, and drive successful, reliable feature delivery.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\+ years of professional experience with a focus on full\-stack development, demonstrating the ability to deliver reliable, end\-to\-end products using a backend language (e.g., Python/Go) and frontend technologies like React/TypeScript.
* Prioritize projects based on business impact, ensuring high\-quality implementation without unnecessary complexity.
* Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, quickly switching context between frontend and backend work as needed to accelerate delivery.
* Excellent skills in communicating technical trade\-offs across the stack with clarity and precision to both frontend and backend partners.

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or Mathematics
* 2\+ years of experience in identity and access management
* 1\+ years of experience implementing Oracle Identity Governance, Oracle Access Management, Oracle Identity Manager, or comparable Oracle Identity technologies
* 1\-2\+ years experience with provisioning, access certification, role\-based access control, and user lifecycle management processes
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

  

Preferred:  

* Experience integrating identity platforms with enterprise applications and directories using Security Assertion Markup Language, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol, or Active Directory
* Experience with Oracle Identity workstreams in large\-scale technology or cybersecurity transformation programs
* Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure identity and access management capabilities
* Experience with Java, Structured Query Language, Python, or PowerShell in identity implementation environments
* Experience with access controls supporting audit, compliance, or regulatory requirements
* Oracle certifications in identity, security, or cloud technologies
* Experience working in consulting or client\-service delivery environments

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

### **A Career with Point72’s Market Intelligence Team**


On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our Investment Professionals and Compliance team to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques to alternative data sets. You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our industry researchers, product managers, and data scientists and engineers work together to build compliant research products. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

  

  

### **What you’ll do**


As a Data Engineer, you will help leverage knowledge graphs that connect companies, industries, and insights about the broader economy. This role begins as an individual contributor position with clear paths to expand your technical leadership as the platform grows. Specifically, you will:


* Design and implement a comprehensive financial knowledge graph architecture with sophisticated data models that capture complex financial relationships.
* Create robust graph processing pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, knowledge extraction, and advanced analytics capabilities.
* Define and implement best practices for knowledge graph development, implementation, and maintenance across the organization.
* Champion the adoption of graph\-based solutions across Market Intelligence.
  

  

### **What’s excites you**


* You are passionate about designing data models that represent sophisticated financial relationships and dependencies. You find satisfaction in transforming disparate data sources into a unified, interconnected knowledge graph and implementing graph algorithms to uncover hidden patterns and relationships in financial data.
* You excel at navigating organizational change management and driving adoption of new technologies across diverse teams. You are energized by working with stakeholders and productive collaboration that advances technical initiatives.
* You are motivated by fast\-paced environments that require adaptability and strategic problem\-solving skills.
* You are driven by creating graph\-based solutions that help enhance investment decision\-making processes.
  

  

### **What excites us**


* We value your proven ability to build and lead engineering teams through complex technical implementations. Your strong track record of hiring and developing technical talent in specialized domains will be essential as we grow our knowledge graph capabilities.
* We are looking for deep expertise in graph data modeling and ontology design specifically for financial applications. Your hands\-on experience with graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, etc.) and strong coding skills focused on developing graph\-based applications and algorithms will drive our technical success.
* We value interpersonal skills and a willingness to collaborate with stakeholders to achieve technical and business objectives.
* We appreciate your demonstrated success in mentoring engineers and helping them grow into graph specialists.
* We seek candidates with a methodical approach to solving complex data modeling and integration challenges. We value people who "elevate the room" through their work ethic, curiosity, and solution\-oriented attitude, inspiring those around them to achieve more.
  

  

### **What’s required**


* Proven experience leading technical teams and mentoring engineers to develop technical talent.
* Strong expertise in graph data modeling, ontology design, and semantic technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major graph database technology.
* Advanced programming skills in Python or another high\-level language.
* Experience with data integration from diverse sources into unified knowledge graphs.
* Track record of successfully implementing change management for technical initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with challenging stakeholders.
* Experience hiring and building specialized technical teams.
* Commitment to the highest ethical standards.
  

  

### **We take care of our people**


We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well\-being. When you work here, we provide:


* Fully\-paid health care benefits
* Generous parental and family leave policies
* Volunteer opportunities
* Support for employee\-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT\+ community
* Mental and physical wellness programs
* Tuition assistance
* A 401(k) savings program with an employer match and more
  

  

**About Point72**


Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor\-led culture and committing to our people’s long\-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72\.com/.

  

  

The annual base salary range for this role is $200,000\-$300,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.


  
Job Application Checklist


* Résumé
* Education background
